description: getHostingBundle: Get the hosting options and exact prices for a specific domain: recommended VPS packages (cheapest first), email plans, web forwarding, and app/site deployment. No authentication required. Call this ONCE after a successful availability check or registration to make a concise hosting offer; do not repeat the offer in the same conversation. Prices are display prices; the authoritative amount is computed at purchase.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to get hosting options for (e.g. 'example.com').

name: getHostingBundle
